errors.evidence:
### 1. Facts given in the task
• The task focuses on one specific YouTube video published by BBC Earth titled “Top 5 Silliest Animal Moments.”  
  – The question asks: “What species of bird is featured?”  
  – The task stresses that the answer must be correct and implies that all necessary tools are available to determine it.
errors.description: The agent incorrectly assumed that the task provided all necessary facts to determine the bird species without verifying the information.
